messages:
sam (support): Heads-up — multiple customers (acme, betaapps) reporting 503s to /v1/generate since ~11:10 UTC. Errors spike for ~10–20s windows and clients are hitting retry loops. We have a customer repro sample and traces.
lee (sre): Ack. Any shared model or route across tenants?
sam (support): All requests target model `redwood-v2-opt`, different tenant ids. Trace snippet shows repeated `route.resolve` failures and short-lived upstream 503s. Example: `route_key=tenant:acme:model:redwood-v2-opt -> upstream 503`.
anya (eng-runtime): Can you paste a minimal repro curl we can run here?
sam (support): Sure — this is what customer used (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-opt","input":"hello","max_tokens":20}'
```
If run 50 concurrent times we see ~15% 503s for a short window.
raj (devex): Noted — SDK v1.4.2 defaults to aggressive retry/backoff which can amplify a fanout. Recommend customers set `maxRetries=1` temporarily or use exponential jitter.
lee (sre): Pulling routing logs now. Quick check: are we seeing any rollout flags for `redwood-v2-opt` pinned differently per cluster?
anya (eng-runtime): Asking runtime team: there was a config tweak yesterday that added a new alias mapping for legacy tenants. Might be a mis-merge causing tenant->alias lookup to force a fallback when KV cache misses.
oncall-bot: Runbook suggestion: 1) apply per-tenant qps throttles to 20r/s, 2) disable aggressive client retries via traffic-control, 3) check KV cache miss rate.
lee (sre): I see a correlation: when KV cache miss rate spikes above ~70% for tenant routing table, requests fall back to a smaller pool that is currently saturated -> 503. Miss rate coincides with a short TTL (30s) we rolled earlier.
deploy-bot: config apply: cluster-12 -> kv_cache_ttl changed from 30 -> 300 (rolling)
anya (eng-runtime): Monitoring p95 and 5xx now. Can someone ask customers to retry with linear backoff while this rolls? Also we'll run a small synthetic hitting exactly the mapping keys.
sam (support): Customer comms sent: "We're investigating, temporary mitigation in progress. ETA ~2h for full follow-up. If you can reduce client retries we'll lessen impact." :thumbsup:
lee (sre): After TTL bump, 5xx rate dropped to baseline in cluster-12. Still watching for other clusters.
raj (devex): We'll push an SDK hotfix in v1.4.3 to reduce retry amplification and add a recommended `maxConcurrency` example in docs.
sam (support): Update: acme and betaapps confirm errors have subsided. Will open a postmortem with root cause + action items (pinning, caches, rollout safeguards).
anya (eng-runtime): Action items: revert alias merge rules until we have canaries, add metric for tenant routing miss rate, and autoscale fallback pool.
sam (support): Thanks all — closing this thread for now, will ping with the postmortem when ready. :heart:
